boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Kettering spaces for individual focus, collaborative work, research support, tutoring, and outdoor study.

cards.title: Put the Whiteboard to Work
cards.subtitle: Collaborative rooms inside the Learning Commons
cards.notes: Bring a group assignment or problem set; use the movable seating, tables, whiteboards, and technology to work through it together.
cards.short_summary: A network of glass-walled collaboration rooms equipped for visible, hands-on group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering says the Learning Commons has more than a dozen d.spaces with couches, chairs, collaboration tables, and whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: University students, faculty, and staff may use these collaborative workspaces; the official page does not state reservation rules or current hours.

cards.title: Take the Reading Outside
cards.subtitle: A powered outdoor workspace above the Learning Commons
cards.notes: Choose a shaded seat, connect your device to an available outlet, and use the terrace for reading or portable coursework in suitable weather.
cards.short_summary: A 1,600-square-foot terrace combining outdoor seating, greenery, hammocks, and electrical power.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering describes the Rooftop Terrace as a 1,600-square-foot outdoor study and relaxation space with seating, green areas, hammocks, and outlets.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access may depend on building access and weather; the official page does not publish separate terrace hours.

cards.title: Start the Source Hunt Here
cards.subtitle: Library support on the Learning Commons third floor
cards.notes: Set up nearby when a research task needs databases or librarian guidance, then use the service point to resolve source and access questions.
cards.short_summary: One of two physical library-service anchors supporting Kettering’s digital collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering’s catalog says Library service desks are on the Learning Commons third and fourth floors and support access to multidisciplinary digital resources.
cards.access_notes: In-person service is available during regular library hours; the cited catalog page does not provide a current daily schedule.

cards.title: Pair Focus Time With Library Help
cards.subtitle: Upper-floor library service in the Learning Commons
cards.notes: Use the upper-floor service point while working through technical papers, standards, journals, or other material in Kettering’s digital collections.
cards.short_summary: An upper-level research stop near spaces intended for individual focus and project work.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering’s catalog identifies a fourth-floor Library service desk, while the Library provides databases, journals, technical papers, and standards.
cards.access_notes: In-person service is available during regular library hours; digital library access is available remotely to Kettering students.

cards.title: Settle Into a Project-Work Floor
cards.subtitle: Two levels organized around study and media support
cards.notes: Use this area for research or project work when you want open study space with a media-support point available on each of its two levels.
cards.short_summary: A two-level study environment centered on project activity and media-specialist support.
cards.evidence_claim: Learning By Design identifies the two-level Information Commons as a project-work and study area with a media specialist center on each floor.
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Learning Commons; the project profile does not state separate access rules or service hours.

cards.title: Work Along the Campus Connector
cards.subtitle: Ground-level gallery between the Learning Commons and Campus Center
cards.notes: Bring lightweight reading or laptop work and use this connecting gallery when you want an indoor setting between the two campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed ground-level gallery integrated into the two-level building connector.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning By Design project profile says the two-level connector to the Campus Center encloses a gallery at ground level.
cards.access_notes: This is an interior connector area; the cited project profile does not specify seating availability, restrictions, or hours.

cards.title: Use the Steps for Informal Learning
cards.subtitle: A presentation and social space for impromptu learning
cards.notes: Choose this setting for conversational review, an informal presentation, or discussion-based work that does not require a closed room.
cards.short_summary: A flexible interior setting designed to support presentations, circulation, and spontaneous learning.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning By Design profile characterizes the Kiva as a dining, presentation, social, and circulation space used for impromptu learning experiences.
cards.access_notes: The Kiva is a shared multipurpose area; check for scheduled presentations or events before arranging group work.

cards.title: Study Under the Four-Story Atrium
cards.subtitle: Open seating beneath a skylit central hub
cards.notes: Pick an open seating area here for laptop work or collaborative tasks when daylight and connection to the building’s other spaces suit the plan.
cards.short_summary: The bright central volume links varied seating and work environments across four floors.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering describes wide-open, technology-enriched Learning Commons spaces, and the project profile identifies a four-story central atrium.
cards.access_notes: This is an open shared area rather than a reservable room; the official page does not state current building hours.

cards.title: Bring the Problem Set to a Tutor
cards.subtitle: Course support for math, science, computing, and writing
cards.notes: Check the term’s support schedule, then bring specific questions for peer help with coursework, code, quantitative problems, or written assignments.
cards.short_summary: A structured academic-support space for tutoring, drop-ins, technical tools, and writing guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering says the ASC Lab provides one-on-one peer tutoring, course drop-in sessions, writing support, and help with MATLAB, Java, and Python.
cards.access_notes: Academic Success Center hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; tutoring and drop-in offerings vary by academic term.

cards.title: Use a Residence-Hall Work Room
cards.subtitle: Six smaller workspaces inside Thompson Hall
cards.notes: If you live in Thompson Hall, take solo or small-group work to one of its six smaller lounges when your room is not the right setup.
cards.short_summary: Residence-hall lounges offering residents an alternative to studying in their private rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering’s Residence Life page says Thompson Hall contains six smaller lounges that offer students private workspaces.
cards.access_notes: Thompson Hall is student housing; use is intended for residents and any guests allowed under current residence-life rules.
